cordican.method: Document ids from the files listing of folder xmlfiles/CORDICan (action=files&folder=...), raw TEI via action=getxml&cid= (the stats action returns an empty reply on this instance); year from the TEI header document date.
cordican.coverage: All 1095 documents in xmlfiles/CORDICan (other folders on the instance excluded).
problems: 9 of 1095 documents have no extractable date in the TEI header: year=None, dateless_in_window=False, so not counted in window (the corpus covers the 16th-19th centuries; some undated ones may be in window).

Only the xmlfiles/CORDICan folder was harvested; the instance also hosts other folders (Irene_Bello, Miguel_Inquisición, Pruebas_curso, Tesis_Cira) and root-level test files, which belong to other projects/tests. Raw TEI XML kept as harvested; year from origDate/msDesc.

cordina-north-america.method: Document ids from the stats pages (action=stats&start=...), raw TEI via action=getxml&cid=; year from the TEI header document date.
cordina-north-america.coverage: All 122 documents listed on the statistics pages.
problems: 0 of 122 documents have no extractable date in the TEI header: year=None, dateless_in_window=False, so not counted in window (the corpus covers the 16th-20th centuries; some undated ones may be in window).
Raw TEI XML kept as harvested (RQ's counter keeps only <text>/<body>); year from origDate/msDesc (document date). Texts also appear in the CHARTA corpus (same CHARTA network files).

nostoi.method: Document ids from the files page (action=files), raw TEI via action=getxml&cid=; prueba* test files excluded; year from the TEI header document date.
nostoi.coverage: All 2 documents in the TEITOK files listing (the corpus is still being built).
problems: 0 of 2 documents have no extractable date in the TEI header: year=None, dateless_in_window=False, so not counted in window.

The TEITOK instance currently holds only 2 corpus documents (NOSTOI-01_HT, NOSTOI-02_CTc); the stats page lists just a test file. The remaining testimonies (NOSTOI-03 to NOSTOI-11) are presented on the static project site but are not yet in the TEITOK corpus.
